description.ja: Figure-riseMechanics ドラえもんに続き、ドラミも登場！
description.en: Figure-riseMechanics Following Doraemon, Dorami also appears!

description.ja: Figure-riseMechanicsはロボットの内部メカニックを組み立てる新境地へ！
description.en: Figure-riseMechanics takes you to a new frontier in assembling the internal mechanics of robots!

description.ja: • ドラミの内部メカのディテールを精密に再現！さらに、あの「リボン形の耳」もメカニクス化！ドラえもんの内部メカとの違いも楽しめます！
description.en: • Precisely reproduce the details of Dorami's internal mechanism! Furthermore, those "ribbon-shaped ears" are now mechanical! Enjoy the differences with Doraemon's internal mechanism!

description.ja: • 内部メカはドラミらしいキュートなカラーリング！
description.en: • The internal mechanism has cute coloring typical of Dorami!

description.ja: • 外装パーツは、通常の黄色に他に、内部メカが透けて見えるクリア外装も付属！
description.en: • In addition to the usual yellow exterior parts, a clear exterior that allows you to see the internal mechanism is also included!

description.ja: • 同時発売「Figure-riseMechanics ドラえもん」と一緒に兄妹でかわいくディスプレイも可能！
description.en: • Simultaneous release: Together with "Figure-riseMechanics Doraemon", you can create a cute display as a brother and sister!
